name: @ceo/desktop
description: KNTY CEO desktop app for executives, admins and heads of department
author: KassLABs

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,app "vite" "wait-on tcp:5175 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5175 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.release:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
